questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Analysis. a dramatic monologue is characterised by:

options.A: A single speaker addressing a silent listener

questions.explanation: A dramatic monologue presents one speaker whose words reveal character.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Analysis. an unreliable narrator is one whose account:
questions.explanation: Readers must question the narrator’s credibility or interpretation.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Poetry. a caesura is:

options.A: A pause within a line of poetry

questions.explanation: A caesura creates a pause within a poetic line.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Terms. situational irony occurs when:

options.A: The outcome differs sharply from expectation

questions.explanation: Situational irony involves an unexpected reversal of circumstances.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Drama. a soliloquy allows a character to:

options.A: Express thoughts while alone on stage
options.B: Address the audience as a chorus

questions.explanation: A soliloquy reveals a character’s inner thoughts.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Narrative. a frame narrative is:

options.A: A story that encloses another story
options.B: A story told only in dialogue

questions.explanation: A framing story provides a structure for one or more embedded narratives.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Criticism. close reading focuses on:

options.A: Detailed analysis of language and form

questions.explanation: Close reading examines diction, syntax, imagery, structure and effects.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Poetry. a volta in a sonnet marks:

options.A: A turn in thought or argument

questions.explanation: The volta signals a shift in perspective, argument or emotion.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Analysis. free indirect discourse blends:

options.A: Third-person narration with a character’s idiom or thoughts

questions.explanation: It allows a character’s perspective to colour third-person narration.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Drama. dramatic irony occurs when:

options.A: The audience knows something a character does not

questions.explanation: The audience’s greater knowledge creates tension or meaning.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Terms. an oxymoron combines:
questions.explanation: An oxymoron places contradictory terms together for effect.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Narrative. analepsis refers to:

options.A: A flashback to an earlier event

questions.explanation: Analepsis is a retrospective narrative shift.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Analysis. a symbol in literature is an element that:

options.A: Suggests meaning beyond its literal role

questions.explanation: A symbol carries additional associations or abstract significance.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Poetry. assonance is the repetition of:
questions.explanation: Assonance repeats vowel sounds within nearby words.
questions.subject: English Elective

questions.question: February challenge: During pre-board application practice, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Literary Criticism. a postcolonial reading often examines:
questions.explanation: Postcolonial criticism studies how colonial power shapes culture, identity and representation.
questions.subject: English Elective
